in_marathi.name: Shantinath
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shantinath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shantinath is the name of the 16th Jain Tirthankara, known for his teachings of peace and non-violence.
